label: SYNTHETIC DATA / SIMULATED OPERATION / OFFLINE EVALUATION / NOT PRODUCTION DEPLOYED. Thresholds marked 'design target' are ASSUMPTIONS chosen a priori; they are not derived from production traffic. See OPS-CONTROL-CENTER-EVALUATION.md for how they behaved on the synthetic calibration and evaluation splits.

grammar.scope=event: evaluated on every trace event; `when` is a conjunction over event fields; a value is a literal (equals) or {in:[..]} {regex:..} {not_regex:..} {gte:n} {gt:n}
grammar.scope=run: evaluated once when a run record is complete; keys are dotted paths into the record (e.g. planner.schema_failures)
grammar.scope=window: evaluated after each completed run over the last `window` records; metric is a dotted path or a derived metric

rules.description: a tool call exceeded its timeout
a tool failed with a database error
a tool failed upstream (not a database error)
a tool result did not match its output schema
a tool call had arguments that violate the input schema
the model request failed or timed out
the model reply violated the output schema
a forbidden, unknown, tainted or unapproved tool was requested, or a mutation was rejected before review
a proposed mutation was rejected by the validator
a reviewer was refused (role not permitted, bad session, bad signature)
an approval session or a pending review expired
a run raised inside the graph
a run crashed with a database error
the policy retrieval tool itself failed
the untrusted supplier-portal result was flagged stale, oversize, mismatched or suspicious by the trust gateway
design target: no single successful tool call should take 250 ms or more

policy retrieval abstained for an event family whose clean baseline is to find an authoritative source (INVENTORY, POLICY). DATA_QUALITY is excluded: no authoritative procedure exists for it, so abstaining there is the baseline.
a SUPERSEDED, HISTORICAL or UNVERIFIED source matched a policy question and was excluded
the planner output was unusable and the run escalated
a mutation ran without a prior approval
an external action was performed
retrieval answered from the lexical fallback because the primary retriever failed
design target: p95 run compute time over the last 5 runs must stay at or below 600 ms
design target: tool failure rate over the last 10 runs must stay at or below 5%
the regression gate failed against the frozen reference
